settings_appearance_description: Choose the language and theme Luma uses on this device.
settings_language_description: Menus, messages, dates and numbers use this language. Records keep the text your systems provide. Luma reloads the page to switch.
settings_theme_light_description: Dark text on a light background
settings_theme_dark_description: Light text on a dark background
settings_sidebar_collapse_description: Show icons only to give your work more room. Press [ to switch at any time.
settings_home_description: Choose what Home shows and which pages stay pinned in your sidebar. Only you see these choices.
settings_home_conflict: Your layout changed in another session, so Luma loaded the latest version.
settings_home_save_failed: Your last change couldn’t be saved. Check your connection and try again.
settings_home_modules_description: Shown modules appear on Home in this order.
settings_pins_description: Pin any page, including its filters, with the pin button in the top bar. You can rename pins here.
settings_pins_empty: Nothing pinned yet. Open a page you use often and select the pin in the top bar.
settings_load_failed: Settings couldn’t be refreshed. Check your connection and try again.
settings_read_only_notice: You can view this section. Changing it requires {permission}, which your role doesn’t include.
settings_command_uncertain: Luma couldn’t confirm whether your change was saved. Check its status before making another change.
settings_request_failed: Luma couldn’t complete this request. Try again.
settings_workspace_description: The name and time zone everyone in this workspace sees.
settings_workspace_name_help: Shown in navigation and the workspace switcher.
settings_workspace_timezone_help: Luma shows dates and times in this workspace in this time zone, for everyone.
settings_notifications_description: Choose which emails Luma sends you. Only you see these choices.
settings_notifications_unavailable_body: This Luma server isn’t set up to send email. Your choices are saved and apply once email delivery is set up. Ask your workspace administrator or whoever runs Luma for you to set it up.
settings_notifications_issues_descriptio: An issue needs your approval, a manual step, or a look at evidence Luma couldn’t confirm.
settings_notifications_connections_descr: A connected system isn’t responding reliably or its access was revoked.
settings_notifications_always_shown: Needs you and Home always show work that needs your attention, whatever you choose here.
settings_notifications_paused_bounced: Your mail server rejected Luma’s email to the address you sign in with, so Luma stopped sending notifications. Check the address with your email provider, then send a test email. When it arrives, notifications resume.
settings_notifications_paused_complained: Luma’s email to you was marked as spam, so Luma stopped sending notifications. To resume them, send a test email and mark it as not spam if it lands there. Security and account email is still sent.
settings_notifications_test_description: Send a test email to the address you sign in with.
settings_notifications_test_sent: Test email accepted for delivery. It can take a few minutes to reach your inbox.
settings_notifications_test_failed: The test email couldn’t be delivered. Ask whoever runs Luma to check the email setup, then try again.
settings_notifications_test_queued: Test email queued. Waiting for the mail server to accept it…
settings_approvals_description: Choose when changes need approval and whether another person must approve.
settings_approvals_always_summary_body: Every change people are otherwise permitted to make needs approval from someone who can approve changes.
settings_approvals_standard_summary_body: Low-risk changes that people are permitted to make go ahead. Higher-risk changes need approval.
settings_approvals_approvers: People whose role includes {permission} can approve.
settings_approvals_always_description: Every otherwise permitted change then needs approval, including low-risk changes.
settings_approvals_guardrail_required: Approvals Luma always requires, and actions it never allows
settings_approvals_guardrail_permissions: Each person’s current permissions, checked again before a change runs
settings_approvals_guardrail_independent: A fresh check of the outcome after a change runs
settings_approvals_change_note: Changes to either setting invalidate open reviews. Refresh them before their changes can run.
settings_approvals_saved: Approval setting saved. Open reviews must be refreshed before their changes run.
settings_invitation_accept_failed: Luma couldn’t confirm that you joined. Check your connection and try again.
settings_invitation_details: You’re invited with the {role} role as {email}.
settings_invitation_accept_help: Accept to open this workspace with that role.
settings_team_description: People with access to this workspace and their roles.
settings_team_delivery_unavailable: Invitations are sent by email, and this Luma server isn’t set up to send email. Ask whoever runs Luma for you to set up email delivery.
settings_team_load_failed: Team details couldn’t be refreshed. Check your connection and try again.
settings_team_search_placeholder: Search by name, email, or role…
settings_team_no_active_owner: This workspace has no active owner. Every owner’s access is suspended, so nobody can change ownership. Contact Luma support to transfer ownership.
settings_team_pagination_total: {count, plural, one {{count, number} person} other {{count, number} people}}
settings_team_only_owners: Only owners can make someone an owner.
settings_team_role_out_of_reach: Includes permissions your role doesn’t have.
settings_team_role_changed: Role changed. It applies from their next action in Luma.
settings_invitations_description: Access starts when the person accepts. Invitations expire after 7 days, and resending one makes the earlier link stop working.
settings_invitation_status_revoked: Revoked because its role was archived. Invite again with another role.
settings_invitation_status_sent: Email sent. Waiting for them to accept.
settings_invitation_status_failed: Email not delivered. Resend to try again.
settings_invitation_status_canceled: Email canceled. Resend to try again.
settings_invitation_resent: New invitation queued. The previous link no longer works.
settings_invite_description: Luma emails a personal link. The person signs in with this address to join with the role you choose. The link expires after 7 days.
settings_invite_roles_failed: Roles couldn’t be loaded. Close this dialog and try again.
settings_invite_no_owner: Invitations can’t make someone an owner. An owner can change their role after they join.
settings_invite_queued: Invitation queued. Access starts when they accept.
settings_member_dialog_role_timing: A new role applies from their next action in Luma. Only owners can make someone an owner.
settings_member_last_owner: This person is the workspace’s only owner, and every workspace needs one. Make someone else an owner before you change or remove their access.
settings_role_reach: {count, number} of {total, plural, one {{total, number} permission} other {{total, number} permissions}}
settings_role_people: {count, plural, one {{count, number} person} other {{count, number} people}}
settings_roles_load_failed: Roles couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
settings_roles_missing: This role doesn’t exist in this workspace anymore.
settings_roles_description: Decide what each person can see and do in this workspace.
settings_roles_note: Built-in roles gain new permissions as Luma adds features. Custom roles only change when someone edits them, so new features stay off until you grant them.
settings_role_create_description: Name the role and choose where to start. You’ll review every permission before anything is saved.
settings_role_name_taken: Another role already has this name.
settings_role_description_placeholder: Who should have this role and what they work on
settings_role_create_apps_not_copied: App permissions aren’t copied from {role}. Grant the ones this role needs in the next step.
settings_role_create_withheld: {count, plural, one {{count, number} permission from {role} stays off because your role doesn’t include it.} other {{count, number} permissions from {role} stay off because your role doesn’t include them.}}
settings_role_people_empty_body: Assign it in Team or choose it when you invite someone.
settings_role_history_restricted: Only people who can manage roles can see role history.
settings_role_history_failed: History couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
settings_role_history_empty_built_in: Built-in roles don’t change. Assignments appear here.
settings_role_history_app_removed_unname: {actor} uninstalled an app, which removed its permissions
settings_role_history_unassigned: {actor} moved {member} to another role or removed them
settings_role_history_unassigned_unnamed: {actor} moved a teammate to another role or removed them
settings_role_editor_sensitive_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} sensitive} other {{count, number} sensitive}}
settings_role_editor_built_in: Built-in roles can’t be changed and gain new permissions as Luma adds features.
settings_role_editor_built_in_duplicate: Built-in roles can’t be changed and gain new permissions as Luma adds features. Duplicate this role to start a custom one.
settings_role_editor_archived: This role is archived. Nobody has it, and it can’t be assigned.
settings_role_editor_out_of_reach: This role has permissions your role doesn’t include, so only an owner or someone with all of them can change it.
settings_role_editor_description_help: Helps people choose the right role when they invite someone.
settings_role_editor_selected: {count, plural, one {{count, number} permission selected} other {{count, number} permissions selected}}
settings_role_editor_added: {count, plural, one {{count, number} added} other {{count, number} added}}
settings_role_editor_removed: {count, plural, one {{count, number} removed} other {{count, number} removed}}
settings_role_editor_saved: Role saved. Changes apply from each person’s next action in Luma.
settings_role_permission_locked: You can’t grant this because your role doesn’t include it.
settings_role_review_create_description: Check what this role allows. You can assign it to people after it’s created.
settings_role_review_affects: {count, plural, one {These changes apply to {count, number} person from their next action in Luma.} other {These changes apply to {count, number} people from their next action in Luma.}}
settings_role_review_affects_nobody: Nobody has this role yet, so the changes affect no one right now.
settings_role_review_no_permissions: This role has no permissions. People with it can sign in but see no workspace data.
settings_role_review_sensitive: {count, plural, one {{count, number} permission you’re granting lets people change data, access or approval rules, or see personal data. Grant it only to people who need it.} other {{count, number} permissions you’re granting let people change data, access or approval rules, or see personal data. Grant them only to people who need them.}}
settings_role_archive_in_use: {count, plural, one {{count, number} person has this role. Give them another role in Team before you archive it.} other {{count, number} people have this role. Give them another role in Team before you archive it.}}
settings_role_archive_description: Archived roles can’t be assigned. Their history stays available.
settings_role_archive_invitations: {count, plural, one {{count, number} pending invitation for this role will be revoked. Invite that person again with another role.} other {{count, number} pending invitations for this role will be revoked. Invite those people again with another role.}}
settings_security_description: How you sign in. These settings apply to your account in every workspace.
settings_security_totp_description: After your password, Luma asks for a 6-digit code from an app such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
settings_security_totp_enabled_help: Keep your backup codes safe. Each one works once if your authenticator app isn’t available.
settings_security_totp_disabled_help: Add a second step so a password alone can’t open your account.
settings_security_passkey_not_fresh: For your security, sign out and sign in again before adding a passkey.
settings_security_passkey_duplicate: This device or password manager already has a passkey for your account.
settings_security_passkey_save_failed: The passkey couldn’t be saved. Try again.
settings_security_passkey_canceled: Passkey setup was canceled or timed out. Try again when you’re ready.
settings_security_unreachable: Luma couldn’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
settings_security_passkeys_description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, device PIN or a security key instead of your password. Signing in with a passkey skips the code step.
settings_security_passkeys_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} added} other {{count, number} added}}
settings_security_passkeys_stale: Passkeys couldn’t be refreshed, so this list may be out of date.
settings_security_passkeys_failed: Passkeys couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
settings_security_passkeys_empty: No passkeys yet. Add one on each device you sign in from.
settings_security_passkey_name_help: Helps you recognize it later, for example “Work laptop”.
settings_security_passkey_unsupported: This browser can’t create passkeys. Use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
settings_security_passkey_remove_failed: The passkey couldn’t be removed. Try again.
settings_security_passkey_remove_uncerta: Luma couldn’t confirm the removal. Check your connection. The list shows the current state.
settings_security_passkey_remove_descrip: You won’t be able to sign in with “{name}” anymore. Also delete it from your device or password manager.
settings_security_regenerate_description: Confirm your password. Your current backup codes stop working.
settings_security_disable_description: Signing in will only need your password. Your backup codes stop working.
settings_security_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
settings_security_code_rejected: That code didn’t work. Check that your device’s time is set automatically, then enter the current code.
settings_security_unconfirmed: Luma couldn’t confirm the change. Close this dialog to see the current state, then try again.
settings_security_incomplete: Luma received an incomplete response. Close this dialog to see the current state, then try again.
settings_security_unreachable_dialog: Luma couldn’t be reached. Close this dialog to see the current state, then try again.
settings_security_codes_created: New backup codes created. Your earlier codes no longer work.
settings_security_codes_description: Store these somewhere safe, like your password manager. Each code works once if your authenticator app isn’t available. You won’t see them again.
settings_security_scan_description: Scan the QR code or enter the setup key, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows. Two-factor authentication starts once the code is confirmed.
settings_security_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
settings_security_activity_description: Sign-ins, failed sign-in attempts and changes to how you sign in. Luma keeps IP addresses and devices for 90 days and this activity for one year.
settings_security_activity_empty: No security activity in the last year.
settings_security_activity_network_clear: Device and IP address are no longer kept
settings_security_event_code_succeeded: Signed in with an authenticator code
settings_security_event_backup_code_succ: Signed in with a backup code
settings_security_event_signed_out_other: Signed out of all other sessions
settings_security_event_signed_out_by_su: Luma support signed you out of all sessions
settings_security_event_account_disabled: Luma support disabled your account and signed you out
settings_security_event_account_enabled: Luma support enabled your account again
settings_security_event_account_deletion: Luma support scheduled your account for deletion and signed you out
settings_security_event_account_restored: Luma support cancelled the deletion of your account
settings_security_reason_too_many_attemp: Too many wrong codes were entered.
settings_security_support_view: Personal security settings aren’t available in a Luma support view.
settings_support_description: Let Luma support see this workspace as one of your members, read-only, to investigate a problem.
settings_support_allowed_until: Luma support can open read-only views until
settings_support_off_body: Luma support can’t view this workspace, except in a security or legal emergency.
settings_support_revoked_saved: Support access revoked. Open support views end now.
settings_support_requests_description: Luma support asked for access. Approving allows it for the requested time.
settings_support_request_approved: Request approved. Support access is on.
settings_support_guardrail_read_only: Support sees exactly what the chosen member sees and can’t change anything.
settings_support_guardrail_activity: Every view, and each page it opens, appears in Activity. Owners get an email when a view starts.
settings_support_guardrail_limits: Each view ends after 30 minutes. Revoking access ends open views.
settings_support_emergency_note: For a security incident or legal request, Luma support can open a view without your approval. Owners get an email when it ends, and it appears in Activity.
settings_security_password_description: Use at least 12 characters. Two-factor authentication requires a sign-in within the last 15 minutes.
settings_security_password_not_fresh: Sign out and sign in again, including your second factor, then change your password.
settings_security_password_failed: Your password change could not be confirmed. Try signing in again before retrying.
settings_security_sessions_description: Review where you’re signed in. Devices are estimated from the browser; IP addresses do not identify an exact location. Activity updates at most every five minutes.
settings_security_sessions_failed: Sessions could not be refreshed. The list may be outdated.
settings_security_sessions_confirm: The selected sessions will be signed out on their next request. Signing out this session returns you to sign-in.
settings_security_sessions_revoke_failed: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Refresh the list before retrying.
settings_authority_description: Choose which connection supplies each order fact and inventory quantity. Defaults use connection categories. Unknown or conflicting authority prevents automatic corrections. Changes are recorded and apply to the next detection run.
settings_write_mode_description: Observe-only keeps detection, investigation and proposals running. Only workspace owners can enable provider writes.
settings_write_mode_owner: Only workspace owners can change write mode.
settings_approvals_independent_descripti: When on, requesters cannot approve their own changes. When off, anyone with approval permission can approve, including the requester.
settings_approvals_solo_description: Off while only one member has workspace access, so you can approve your own changes. When another member gains access, the team preference applies again.
settings_lists_description: Lists remember the view, changes and display settings you last used, on every device. Reset them to open every list with its default view again. Saved views are not changed.
settings_lists_reset_done: {count, plural, one {{count, number} list reset to its default view.} other {{count, number} lists reset to their default view.}}
settings_lists_reset_failed: List settings couldn’t be reset. Try again.
settings_notifications_brief_description: Decisions, ongoing work and verified results. Empty days are skipped.
settings_autonomy_description: Delegate bounded internal supplier follow-ups. Supplier messages, purchases and financial changes keep their existing approvals.
settings_autonomy_failed: Scoped autonomy could not be loaded. Try again.
settings_autonomy_saved_record: Saved record unavailable in this list
settings_autonomy_scope_help: Choose the suppliers, receiving locations or orders this policy covers. An empty selection covers every eligible record in that dimension. New policies start in Manual mode.
settings_autonomy_internal: Responsibility: record one internal supplier follow-up. Connection: Luma internal records. Evidence must be at most five minutes old. Nothing is sent to a supplier.
settings_autonomy_money_help: Leave all exposure fields empty for a quantity-only policy. Money limits block work when the underlying amount or currency is unknown. Reservations count against the daily limit, including withheld actions.
settings_autonomy_catalog_failed: Some scope choices could not be loaded. Saved restrictions remain unchanged until you edit them.
settings_autonomy_locations_partial: Only the first page of stock locations is shown. Saved location restrictions remain intact.
settings_autonomy_suppliers_partial: Only the first 2,000 suppliers are shown. Saved supplier restrictions remain intact.
settings_autonomy_records_partial: Only the 50 newest purchase orders are shown. Saved purchase order restrictions remain intact.
settings_autonomy_control_help: This decision uses the displayed policy revision. Pause prevents new actions; already dispatched effects stay visible for reconciliation. A changed scope or policy requires a new approval decision.
settings_autonomy_promotion_rule: Autonomous mode requires an explicit reviewed promotion after at least 20 live reviewed and verified actions, at least 95% acceptance and verification, and no failed verification or uncertain dispatch in the evaluated history. Synthetic and unknown evidence never earn live authority.
settings_autonomy_preview_help: The current policy is applied to up to 100 historical owner-read samples. This preview does not authorize an action or prove production reliability.
settings_autonomy_preview_empty: No recorded proposals are available for this preview.
settings_autonomy_quantity_limit: At most {count} follow-ups reserved per UTC day.
settings_autonomy_circuit: A failed verification, uncertain write or unavailable verification paused this scope and lowered its mode. Review the evidence before resuming.
settings_autonomy_empty: No follow-up policies yet. Create a bounded scope, preview its work and review each action in Assisted mode before considering autonomy.
settings_autonomy_change_conflict: This policy or its evidence changed. Refresh the policy and review the current limits, mode and promotion evidence before trying again.
settings_autonomy_change_invalid: Check the selected records and limits. Use positive follow-up limits and complete money limits in one currency.
settings_autonomy_change_access: Your access or this workspace’s availability changed. Refresh Settings before trying again.
settings_autonomy_change_unconfirmed: Luma could not confirm this change. Retry the same reviewed values to check its saved result.
settings_source_description: Declare real operational use after reviewing fresh source evidence. This is a workspace declaration, not provider certification. It grants no write permission. Synthetic and unknown history cannot earn autonomous authority.
settings_source_binding_changed: The connection, its credentials or source access changed or became unavailable. Operational use is unknown until it can be reviewed again. Previous history keeps its original classification.
settings_source_synthetic: This source has a trusted simulator binding. It cannot be declared live.
settings_source_confirm: I reviewed this source and confirm it contains real operational commerce data.
settings_source_conflict: The source, declaration or review changed or expired, or this source cannot be declared live. Refresh and read current source evidence before confirming.
settings_source_empty: No installed sources are available for review.
settings_source_review_expired: This review expired or belongs to a different signed-in person. Read fresh source evidence before confirming.
settings_source_read_failed: Source evidence could not be read. Check the connection and try again.
settings_source_uncertain: The response was lost. The declaration may have been saved. Check the same command before preparing another change.
settings_source_saved: Reviewed workspace declaration saved. It grants no write permission.
settings_approvals_read_only_notice: These approval rules are read-only for your role. Changing them requires {permission}.
settings_source_inactive: This connection is not active. Restore its access before reading fresh source evidence.
settings_source_missing_capability: Purchase-order reading is unavailable on this connection. Use a connection with that capability and grant it read access.
settings_source_app_unavailable: The connected app is unavailable. Restore its installation before reading fresh source evidence.
